svg.data-weight-note: 21.7 lb (9.84 kg) with power supplies and fan modules installed (Table 4)
svg.data-depth-note: 20.48 in (52.02 cm); Table 4 prints 4.37 cm in the metric column, a slip
svg.data-forwarding-rate: 1,071 Mpps at 64 byte packets, wire speed (datasheet)
svg.data-buffers: 12 MB shared, 25 percent dedicated (guide, Benefits of the EX4600 Switch)
svg.data-sfp-plus-speeds: 10 or 1 GbE on each SFP+ port
svg.data-qsfp-plus-speeds: 40 GbE, or 4 x 10 GbE with a breakout cable
svg.data-power-datasheet-load-w: 279 W AFO, 285 W AFI, 392 W DC-AFO, 320 W DC-AFI at the datasheet's stated load
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz; 4.5 A at 100 to 120 VAC, 2.0 A at 200 to 240 VAC
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating range -40 to -72 VDC, 10 A maximum
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, 1+1; the switch runs on one
svg.data-fans: five fan modules and a fan in each supply; the switch runs 30 seconds while one fan module is replaced
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing in operation, 0 to 95 percent out of operation
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches in a ring; mixed with EX4300 switches
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10 GbE SFP+ and 1 GbE SFP in any port; a restriction on 1 GbE copper SFP stacked above or below another (guide, Port Panel)
svg.data-optics-qsfp: 40 GbE QSFP+, or 4 x 10 GbE with a breakout cable
svg.data-expansion: two bays, QFX-EM-4Q (4 x 40 GbE QSFP+) and EX4600-EM-8F (8 x 10 GbE SFP+), 72 ports at most
svg.data-oob: one RJ-45 (C0, em0) and one SFP (C1, em1) management port
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A, EN 55022 Class A, VCCI Class A, BSMI CNS 13438, AS/NZS CISPR22
svg.data-nebs: GR-63-Core, GR-1089-Core, SR-3580 NEBS Criteria Level 3 (as the datasheet lists them)
svg.data-materials: RoHS 6/6, China RoHS, REACH, WEEE, 80 Plus Silver supply efficiency
